Package aor.proj3t.dto

Class FileUploadDTO

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.dto.FileUploadDTO
public class FileUploadDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object for file uploads.

Represents metadata and binary content for uploaded files, typically consumed by REST endpoints that support multipart or base64-encoded file transmission. Includes fields for filename, MIME type, extension, and raw content. JAXB-compatible for XML marshalling if required.

Attributes: - fileName: Original name of the file (without path) - fileContent: Binary content of the file as a byte array - fileMimeType: MIME type string (e.g. "image/png", "application/pdf") - fileExtension: File extension (e.g. "png", "jpg", "pdf") Common use cases include profile picture uploads, document storage, and temporary in-memory file handling before persistence.
